An appeal by Richard Cowan November 1, 2005
How time flies when you are not in jail! MarijuanaNews will soon be eight years old.

It began on a dial up connection in late November of 1997. I had previously set up MarijuanaMagazine.com for the late Peter McWilliams.
See
 Author Handcuffed as the DEA Searches Home After He Runs Variety Ad Critical of DEA.
and
 The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary  by Richard Cowan

Nonetheless, I really did not have any idea what I was getting into. Perhaps I still do not.

At first, I got very busy trying to gather as many news stories as possible to document both the current history of marijuana prohibition and also the media bias that created and perpetuates it.
See how little some things have changed
 Washington Post Launches New Prohibitionist Propaganda Campaign (Two Long Articles)  
(From November of 1997. The Posts links are dead, but the problem is clear.)

Fortunately, Mapinc.org began about the same time, and when its archives began to exceed mine, I decided to concentrate on other things.
Such as
 RCMP Report On The Drug Situation in Canada  2004 Contradicts The Prohibitionist Party Line  Again. Mexico Supplies US With At Least 25 Times More Than Canada. Ontario Rivals British Columbia .
and
 Mexico, the Drugwar and the US National Interest: Never Mind Iraq; We Need To Pay Attention to What We Are Doing to Our Southern Neighbor.

I would really like to be able to devote my time to analytical writing. However, all too often I find myself personally involved as my friends fight for their lives.
See
 Steve Tuck Now Free and Getting Proper Medical Care. Will Return to Humboldt to Confront Medical Marijuana Cultivation Charges. The Many Issues In a Complex Case.
and
The Paupers of Pot and the Politics of Cannabis Prohibition In Canada. The Other Cases Raise Questions That Canada Must Answer. Will Canada Murder Michelle Rainey?  
and
 Placer County, Still Murderous After All These Years. Kubbys Find Secret Death Warrant Signed by Disqualified Judge. Key To Canadian Refuge, If Not Justice In California.

That certainly makes it easier to keep my own minor problems in perspective, but right now I do have a problem.

I hate asking for your financial support, but.

I have been working on ways to make MarijuanaNews more economically viable by setting it up to run commercial ads and then more effective by building up the traffic to the website  which would make advertising more attractive, etc.

However, I have been a bit distracted of late, and I am behind schedule. Consequently, I have to overcome my embarrassment and rattle my tin cup again.

I am reluctant to put myself in competition with all of the other worthy causes out there, but if you find that MarijuanaNews is valuable to you, I hope that you can find a way to help cover the costs.

Many thanks,
Richard Cowan

The vulgar details:

The easiest and quickest way to make a contribution would be to click on the Paypal button on the top left of the page.
If you have any questions or want to make other arrangements, you can email me cowan@MarijuanaNews.com  

More that you will find only on MarijuanaNews:
 George Will Quotes The Czar Quoting Lincoln and Quotes The Czar Lying, So I Will Quote George Will. And A Few Others.
and
 Big Brother Is Sniffing You  And Without Going to the Dogs. New Technologies and Court Rulings Could Raise More Threats to Cannabis Community. MarijuanaNews Exclusive.
and
 What If Terri Schiavo Needed Medical Cannabis to Live? Selective Compassion and the Rule of Law.
and
 How The Canadian Media Import Counterfeit News From The States. The Drug Czar Lies and Even The Best Papers Dont Check the Facts.
and
 Front Page Fantasy: The New York Times Pushes Fact Free Journalism Supposedly About BC Bud
and
Meth and Marijuana. Now: How the Narks Created Crank in Canada. The Iron Law of Drug Prohibition. The Inescapable Economics Of Contraband.  
and
 Time Magazine Reports BC Bud 20% Less Potent Than Four Years Ago??  Incompetent Prohibitionist Propaganda and Even Worse Journalism. As Some Reporters Die to Find the Truth Others Live to Lie.
and
 European Study Shows Potency of Prohibitionist Propaganda. CBS and The AP Lie to the American People About the Dutch. Surprise! and
Abuse In Prisons: Iraqi and American. Bush says, That is not the way we do things in America. No, That Is Exactly The Way We Do Things in America! Especially In Texas and Florida.
and
 Bush Should Have John  Comical Ali  Walters Explain The Iraq War, Then The Media Would Never Ask Any Embarrassing Questions. Doctrine Of Drug Czar Infallibility? Blame Canada, Again.
and
 The Theory and Practice of Chaos  Analysis By Richard Cowan
